title: JSON Web Token (JWT)
description: Enables user authentication through a JSON Web Token (JWT).

settings_def.name: url
settings_def.label: Remote Login URL
settings_def.description: This is the URL to the page that will generate the JWT token. A user is also sent here if they forgot their password.

settings_def.name: secret
settings_def.label: JWT Secret Code
settings_def.description: This secret code is used by your programmer to create the JWT tokens.

settings_def.name: login_custom_text
settings_def.label: Login Button Text
settings_def.description: The text that appears on the button on the login page. Only useful if your settings are for background SSO. This is also optional - leave blank to show no button.

settings_def.name: logout_agent_url
settings_def.label: Agent Logout Redirect
settings_def.description: The URL we redirect to after an agent logs out (only applies if SSO is enabled)

settings_def.name: logout_user_url
settings_def.label: User Logout Redirect
settings_def.description: The URL we redirect to after a user logs out (only applies if SSO is enabled)

settings_def.name: sso_type
settings_def.label: SSO Method
settings_def.description: When SSO is enabled, users will be automatically logged-in when they visit DeskPRO.
